verses.original: ik oNkaar
verses.translation: There is Only One God

verses.original: Sat Naam
verses.translation: Truth is His Name

verses.original: kartaa purakh nirbh-a-o nirvair akaal moorat
verses.translation: He is the Creator, Protector, Without Fear, No Enmity, a Form(Moorat) which does not exist in Time(Akaal),

verses.original: ajoonee saibhN gur parsaad. jap.
verses.translation: Never born, Self-perpetuating; With the Guru’s grace: Recite!

verses.original: aad sach jugaad sach.
verses.translation: True in the beginning, True Through the Ages,

verses.original: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach.
verses.translation: True even now and says Nanak will be True in the future

verses.original: sochai soch naa hov-a-ee jay sochee lakh vaar
verses.translation: By bathing at holy places a hundred thousand times, one cannot find God

verses.original: chupai chup naa hov-a-ee jay laa-i rahaa liv taar
verses.translation: By keeping Silence fast (Mon vrat) , one cannot find God

verses.original: bhukhi-aa bhukh naa utree jay bannaa puree-aa bhaar
verses.translation: By keeping hunger fast, one cannot find God

verses.original: sehas si-aanpaa lakh hoh taa ik naa chalai naal
verses.translation: One may possess a hundred thousand clever ideas, but even one will not accompany him/her*

verses.original: kiv sachi-aaraa ho-ee-ai kiv koorhai tutai paal
verses.translation: How then can one be purified? How can one throw away the falsehood?

verses.original: hukam rajaa-ee chalnaa naanak likhi-aa naal
verses.translation: Says Nanak, By being content with the Command of God, which is pre-written for everyone!

verses.original: hukmee hovan aakaar hukam na kahi-aa jaa-ee.
verses.translation: By Your Command creatures get body (shape). Your Command cannot be described(said).

verses.original: hukmee hovan jee-a hukam milai vadi-aa-ee.
verses.translation: With your Command soul comes into body and respect is attained.

verses.original: hukmee utam neech hukam likh dukh sukh paa-ee-ah.
verses.translation: By Your Command some are great and some low. With Your Command we receive suffering and happiness.

verses.original: iknaa hukmee bakhsees ik hukmee sadaa bhavaa-ee-ah.
verses.translation: With Your Command some are blessed. With your Command some are always emotionally attached (stuck in cycle of life and birth).

verses.original: hukmai andar sabh ko baahar hukam na ko-ay.
verses.translation: The Commander is inside Everyone, It doesn't exist outside the person.

verses.original: naanak hukmai jay bujhai ta ha-umai kahai na ko-ay.
verses.translation: Says Nanak, "Whosoever realizes Your Command, Never speaks in ego."

verses.original: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan. gaavai ko daat jaanai neesaan.
verses.translation: Many sing of His power, but few possess that power. The ones who are altruistic are known as his sign.

verses.original: gaavai ko gun vadi-aa-ee-aa chaar. gaavai ko vidi-aa vikham veechaar.
verses.translation: Many sing of virtues, praises and greatness. Many sing of knowledge, wisdom and understanding.

verses.original: gaavai ko saaj karay tan khayh. gaavai ko jee-a lai fir dayh.
verses.translation: Many sing about how He fashions the body and then turns it to dust. Many sing about how takes soul then give it back.

verses.original: gaavai ko jaapai disai door. gaavai ko vaykhai haadraa hadoor.
verses.translation: Many sing, that he is out of reach, Many sing that He watches, is ever-present one-on-one.

verses.original: kathnaa kathee na aavai tot. kath kath kathee kotee kot kot.
verses.translation: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach. Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

verses.original: daydaa day laiday thak paahi. jugaa jugantar khaahee khaahi.
verses.translation: The Great Giver keeps on giving, the receivers grow weary of receiving. Throughout the ages, the consumers keep on consuming.

verses.original: hukmee hukam chalaa-ay raahu. naanak vigsai vayparvaahu.
verses.translation: he who walks on the Path of his command. O Nanak, only He blossoms forth, carefree and untroubled.

verses.original: saachaa saahib saach naa-ay bhaakhi-aa bhaa-o apaar.
verses.translation: True Master, True is His Name - Meditate it with utmost humility and deep love.

verses.original: aakhahi mangahi dayhi dayhi daat karay daataar.
verses.translation: Ask and plead, "Give, give" - The Giver gives in abundance.

verses.original: fayr ke agai rakhee-ai jit disai darbaar.
verses.translation: What should we place before him, when we meet him in his Darbar (day of judgement)?

verses.original: muhou ke bolan bolee-ai jit sun Dharay pi-aar.
verses.translation: with mouth utter words of his love.

verses.original: amrit vaylaa sach naa-o vadi-aa-ee veechaar.
verses.translation: In the Early dawn (4-5 am) period, dwell upon His True Name and praises.

verses.original: karmee aavai kaprhaa nadree mokh du-aar.
verses.translation: karma is the cloth soul wears, ones with clean clothes will pass through the Gate of liberation.

verses.original: naanak evai jaanee-ai sabh aapay sachiaar.
verses.translation: says Nanak, know this is the way to get purified.

verses.original: thaapi-aa na jaa-ay keetaa na ho-ay. aapay aap niranjan so-ay.
verses.translation: He cannot be contained; he is not performed. He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.

verses.original: jin sayvi-aa tin paa-i-aa maan. naanak gaavee-ai gunee niDhaan.
verses.translation: Whoever serves Him receives honor. O Nanak sing - "Only Lord has endless Virtues".

verses.original: gaavee-ai sunee-ai man rakhee-ai bhaa-o. dukh parhar sukh ghar lai jaa-ay.
verses.translation: Sing, listen, and keep your mind humble. Suffering will be attacked, and peace will take your mind.

verses.original: gurmukh naadaN gurmukh vaydaN gurmukh rahi-aa samaa-ee.
verses.translation: Gurmukh (one who submits to God) speaks like the Sound-current of the Naad, posesses wisdom of the Vedas and is absorbed by God.

verses.original: gur eesar gur gorakh barmaa gur paarbatee maa-ee.
verses.translation: The Guru (God) is in Shiva, Gorak, Brahma, Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

verses.original: jay ha-o jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahnaa kathan na jaa-ee.
verses.translation: He who possesses this knowledge, cannot describe it in in words.

verses.original: guraa ik dayhi bujhaa-ee. sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaa-ee. 5
verses.translation: One thing about God I have understood completely :All creatures have only the one God – May I never forget this! 5

verses.original: tirath naavaa jay tis bhaavaa vin bhaanay ke naa-ay karee.
verses.translation: I would bath at holy places, if it pleases my Lord, But I do only the things God tells me to do.

verses.original: jaytee sirath upaa-ee vaykhaa vin karmaa ke milai la-ee.
verses.translation: I gaze upon His Creation: without good karmas, what will they receive?

verses.original: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik jay ik gur kee sikh sunee.
verses.translation: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, when the Sikh listens to the One Guru.

verses.original: guraa ik dayhi bujhaa-ee.
verses.translation: The Guru has extinguished this doubt:

verses.original: sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaa-ee.
verses.translation: All creatures have only the one God – May I never forget this! 6

verses.original: jay jug chaaray aarjaa hor dasoonee ho-ay.
verses.translation: Even if you lived the four ages, or even ten times more,

verses.original: navaa khanda vich jaanee-ai naal chalai sabh ko-ay.
verses.translation: and even if you were known throughout the nine kingdoms and everyone followed you,

verses.original: changa naa-o rakhaa-ay kai jas keerat jag lay-ay.
verses.translation: with a good name and reputation, the whole world sang your praises –

verses.original: jay tis nadar na aavee ta vaat na puchhai kay.
verses.translation: still, if you do not please the Lord, no one will ask about you!

verses.original: keetaa andar keet kar dosee dos Dharay.
verses.translation: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

verses.original: naanak nirgun gun karay gunvanti-aa gun day.
verses.translation: O Nanak, He makes unworthy, worthy and gives virtues to the virtuous.

verses.original: tayhaa ko-ay na sujh-ee je tis gun ko-ay karay. 7
verses.translation: I know of no other who can grant so much to others! 7

verses.original: suni-ai siDh peer sur naath.
verses.translation: Listening to God's name - a person becomes saint, priest, warrior and recluse.

verses.original: suni-ai Dharat Dhaval aakaas.
verses.translation: Listening - the earth, its support and sky become same for the person.

verses.original: suni-ai deep lo-a paataal.
verses.translation: Listening - brightens even hell.

verses.original: suni-ai pohi na sakai kaal.
verses.translation: Listening - Time cannot even touch you

verses.original: naanak bhagtaa sadaa vigaas.
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: suni-ai dookh paap kaa naas.
verses.translation: Listening - pain and sin are destroyed. 8

verses.original: suni-ai eesar barmaa ind.
verses.translation: Listening - a person becomes capable of doing anything (Ishwar in Sanskrit), grows (Brahma) and collects more (Indra).

verses.original: suni-ai mukh saalaahan mand.
verses.translation: Listening - even the idiot shall become capable of giving advice to others.

verses.original: suni-ai jog jugat tan bhayd.
verses.translation: Listening - a person Yoga, World and the secrets of the body are known.

verses.original: suni-ai saasat simrit vayd.
verses.translation: Listening – politics meditation and the Vedas are learnt.

verses.original: naanak bhagtaa sadaa vigaas.
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: suni-ai dookh paap kaa naas. 9
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are destroyed. 9

verses.original: suni-ai sat santokh gi-aan.
verses.translation: Listening - a person recieves true contentment and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: suni-ai athsath kaa isnaan.
verses.translation: Listening - is like bathing at the sixty-eight holy places.

verses.original: suni-ai parh parh paavahi maan.
verses.translation: Listening - reading and reciting, honor is obtained.

verses.original: suni-ai laagai sahj Dhi-aan.
verses.translation: Listening – one attains concentration.

verses.original: naanak bhagtaa sadaa vigaas.
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: suni-ai dookh paap kaa naas. 10
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. 10

verses.original: suni-ai saraa gunaa kay gaah.
verses.translation: Listening - dive deep into the ocean of virtue.

verses.original: suni-ai saykh peer paatisaah.
verses.translation: Listening - a person becomes religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.

verses.original: suni-ai anDhay paavahi raahu.
verses.translation: Listening - even the blind find the Path.

verses.original: suni-ai haath hovai asgaahu.
verses.translation: Listening - the Unreachable comes within grasp.

verses.original: naanak bhagtaa sadaa vigaas.
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: suni-ai dookh paap kaa naas. 11
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. 11

verses.original: mannay kee gat kahee na jaa-ay.
verses.translation: The state of the Believer cannot be described.

verses.original: jay ko kahai pichhai pachhutaa-ay.
verses.translation: The One who tries shall regret the attempt.

verses.original: kaagad kalam na likhanhaar.
verses.translation: Neither paper nor pen can narrate.

verses.original: mannay kaa bahi karan veechaar.
verses.translation: Many study the concept of faith.

verses.original: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.
verses.translation: Such personality obtains purity.

verses.original: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. 12
verses.translation: If one understands mind is different than self. 12

verses.original: mannai surat hovai man buDh.
verses.translation: With faith, appeasing appearance and enlightenment is obtained.

verses.original: mannai sagal bhavan kee suDh.
verses.translation: With faith, all types of realms are understood.

verses.original: mannai muhi chotaa naa khaa-ay.
verses.translation: The faithful do not face trouble.

verses.original: mannai jam kai saath na jaa-ay.
verses.translation: The faithful do not go with the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.
verses.translation: Such personality obtains purity.

verses.original: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. 13
verses.translation: If one understands mind is different than self. 13

verses.original: mannai maarag thaak na paa-ay.
verses.translation: The path of the faithful is never blocked.

verses.original: mannai pat si-o pargat jaa-ay.
verses.translation: The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.

verses.original: mannai mag na chalai panth.
verses.translation: The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.

verses.original: mannai Dharam saytee san-banDh.
verses.translation: The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.

verses.original: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.
verses.translation: Such personality obtains purity.

verses.original: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. 14
verses.translation: If one understands mind is different than self.14

verses.original: mannai paavahi mokh du-aar.
verses.translation: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.

verses.original: mannai parvaarai saaDhaar.
verses.translation: The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.

verses.original: mannai tarai taaray gur sikh.
verses.translation: The faithful swim through the sea of life, The Guru(Creator) keeps him afloat.

verses.original: mannai naanak bhavahi na bhikh.
verses.translation: The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.

verses.original: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.
verses.translation: Such personality obtains purity.

verses.original: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. 15
verses.translation: If one understands mind is different than self. 15

verses.original: panch parvaan panch parDhaan. panchay paavahi dargahi maan.
verses.translation: The chosen are accepted and preside. The chosen are honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: panchay sohahi dar raajaan. panchaa kaa gur ayk Dhi-aan.
verses.translation: The chosen look beautiful in the courts of kings. The chosen meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.

verses.original: jay ko kahai karai veechaar. kartay kai karnai naahee sumaar.
verses.translation: What is said, mediate on this thought. the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.

verses.original: Dhoul Dharam da-i-aa kaa poot. santokh thaap rakhi-aa jin soot.
verses.translation: Bull, the Dharma, is the son of compassion; Contentment patiently holds it in its place.

verses.original: jay ko bujhai hovai sachiaar. Dhavlai upar kaytaa bhaar.
verses.translation: One who understands becomes pure. What is the great load on the bull?

verses.original: Dhartee hor parai hor hor. tis tay bhaar talai kavan jor
verses.translation: There is another world, then many, more and more! Who holds their weight in balance with this force?

verses.original: jee-a jaat rangaa kay naav. sabhnaa likhi-aa vurhee kalaam.
verses.translation: Beings, species, colors have names. were all inscribed by the Almighty’s Pen

verses.original: ayhu laykhaa likh jaanai ko-ay. laykhaa likhi-aa kaytaa ho-ay.
verses.translation: This written account is only known to a few? How massive is this written account?

verses.original: kaytaa taan su-aalihu roop. kaytee daat jaanai koun koot.
verses.translation: So many are given power, so many beauty! So many gifts given! Who can know their limit?

verses.original: keetaa pasaa-o ayko kavaa-o. tis tay ho-ay lakh daree-aa-o.
verses.translation: He created the Universe with One Word! Within it flow hundreds of thousands of rivers.

verses.original: kudrat kavan kahaa veechaar. vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.
verses.translation: Think about the mighty Creative Potency? I cannot even begin to describe You.

verses.original: jo tuDh bhaavai saa-ee bhalee kaar. too sadaa salaamat nirankaar.16
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, All will be blessed, You always protect us, Formless One! 16

verses.original: asaNkh jap asaNkh bhaa-o. asaNkh poojaa asaNkh tap taa-o.
verses.translation: Countless mediate, countless yearn. Countless worship, countless exercise self-restrain.

verses.original: asaNkh garanth mukh vayd paath. asaNkh jog man rahahi udaas.
verses.translation: Countless recite granths and Vedas prayers. Countless Yogis detached their minds from the world.

verses.original: asaNkh bhagat gun gi-aan veechaar. asaNkh satee asaNkh daataar.
verses.translation: Countless devotees contemplate the Virtues and Wisdom. Countless sacrifice; countless donate.

verses.original: asaNkh soor muh bhakh saar. asaNkh mon liv laa-ay taar.
verses.translation: Countless warriors, face attack head on. Countless in silence, focus their thoughts.

verses.original: kudrat kavan kahaa veechaar. vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.
verses.translation: Think about the mighty Creative Potency? I cannot even begin to describe You.

verses.original: jo tuDh bhaavai saa-ee bhalee kaar. too sadaa salaamat nirankaar. 17
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, All will be blessed, You always protect us, Formless One! 17

verses.original: asaNkh moorakh anDh ghor. asaNkh chor haraamkhor.
verses.translation: Countless fools, blinded in darkness. Countless thieves and cheaters.

verses.original: asaNkh amar kar jaahi jor. asaNkh galvadh hati-aa kamaahi.
verses.translation: Countless impose their will by force. Countless cut-throats and gather sins.

verses.original: asaNkh paapee paap kar jaahi. asaNkh koorhi-aar koorhay firaahi.
verses.translation: Countless sinners who keep on sinning. Countless liars, wander lost in their lies.

verses.original: asaNkh malaychh mal bhakh khaahi. asaNkh nindak sir karahi bhaar.
verses.translation: Countless wretches, eat filth for food. Countless slanders, make their heads heavy

verses.original: naanak neech kahai veechaar. vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.
verses.translation: Lowly Nanak, gives this explanation. I cannot even begin to describe You.

verses.original: jo tuDh bhaavai saa-ee bhalee kaar. too sadaa salaamat nirankaar. 18
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, All will be blessed, You always protect us, Formless One! 18

verses.original: asaNkh naav asaNkh thaav. agamm agamm asaNkh lo-a.
verses.translation: Countless names, countless places. Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial bodies.

verses.original: asaNkh kehahi sir bhaar ho-ay. akhree naam akhree saalaah.
verses.translation: Even to call them countless is to carry weight on your head. The Word brings Naam; the Word brings Praise.

verses.original: akhree gi-aan geet gun gaah. akhree likhan bolan baan.
verses.translation: The Word brings wisdom and the singing of songs of His Glory. The Word brings the written and spoken words and hymns.

verses.original: akhraa sir sanjog vakhaan. jin ayhi likhay tis sir naahi.
verses.translation: The Word brings destiny written on one's forehead. But Writer of the destiny – None are written on His Forehead.

verses.original: jiv furmaa-ay tiv tiv paahi. jaytaa keetaa taytaa naa-o. vin naavai naahee ko thaa-o.
verses.translation: As He proclaims, so do we receive.Whatever You do, its in Your Name. Without Your Name, there is no place at all.

verses.original: kudrat kavan kahaa veechaar. vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.
verses.translation: Think about the mighty Creative Potency? I cannot even begin to describe You.

verses.original: jo tuDh bhaavai saa-ee bhalee kaar. too sadaa salaamat nirankaar.19
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, All will be blessed, You always protect us, Formless One! 19

verses.original: bharee-ai hath pair tan dayh. paanee Dhotai utras khayh.
verses.translation: Hands, feet and the body that are polluted, With water the dirt can be washed away.

verses.original: moot paleetee kaparh ho-ay. day saaboon la-ee-ai oh Dho-ay.
verses.translation: Clothes that are soiled and stained by urine, With soap they can be washed clean.

verses.original: bharee-ai mat paapaa kai sang. oh Dhopai naavai kai rang.
verses.translation: When the intellect is stained and polluted by sin, That can be cleansed by the Color of the Naam.

verses.original: punnee paapee aakhan naahi. kar kar karnaa likh lai jaahu.
verses.translation: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words; actions repeated, again and again, are engraved on the soul.

verses.original: aapay beej aapay hee khaahu. naanak hukmee aavhu jaahu. 20
verses.translation: What you sow is what you shall eat.O Nanak, by God's Command, we die and take birth. 20

verses.original: tirath tap da-i-aa dat daan. jay ko paavai til kaa maan.
verses.translation: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity. these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.

verses.original: suni-aa mani-aa man keetaa bhaa-o. antargat tirath mal naa-o.
verses.translation: By listening and believing bring humility in your mind; Within the sacred inner shrine, cleanse your mind.

verses.original: sabh gun tayray mai naahee ko-ay. vin gun keetay bhagat na ho-ay.
verses.translation: Lord, all virtues are Yours, none are mine. Without these gifted virtues so many saints would not have existed.

verses.original: su-asat aath banee barmaa-o. sat suhaan sadaa man chaa-o.
verses.translation: Forever vibrate the Bani of Brahma. O Mind, forever seek the Companionship of Truth.

verses.original: kavan so vaylaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar. kavan se rutee maahu kavan jit ho-aa aakaar.
verses.translation: What is that time, that moment? What is that day, that date? What is that season, that month, when the Universe was created?

verses.original: vayl na paa-ee-aa pandtee je hovai laykh puraan. vakhat na paa-i-o kaadee-aa je likhan laykh kuraan.
verses.translation: The Pandits, who have the writings of the Puraans, cannot provide this time. The time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

verses.original: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa ko-ee. jaa kartaa sirthee ka-o saajay aapay jaanai so-ee.
verses.translation: The day and date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season. The Creator who created this creation only He Himself knows.

verses.original: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee ki-o varnee kiv jaanaa. naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik doo ik si-aanaa.
verses.translation: How does one describe or give an opinion of Him or praise or get to know Him? Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, one wiser than the next!

verses.original: vadaa saahib vadee naa-ee keetaa jaa kaa hovai. naanak jay ko aapou jaanai agai ga-i-aa na sohai. 21
verses.translation: The Great Master with a Great Name by His doing - everything happens. O Nanak, one who thinks he knows all, shall not move forwarded. 21

verses.original: paataalaa paataal lakh aagaasaa aagaas.
verses.translation: Planets upon planets and hundreds of thousands of skies upon skies.

verses.original: orhak orhak bhaal thakay vayd kahan ik vaat.
verses.translation: Forever and ever, one can search until one grows tired, the Vedas say one thing;

verses.original: sahas athaarah kahan kataybaa asuloo ik Dhaat.
verses.translation: The scriptures speak of 18,000 worlds, in reality there is only One Universe.

verses.original: laykhaa ho-ay ta likee-ai laykhai ho-ay vinaas.
verses.translation: If one had the knowledge, one could write the account, but it could not be finished.

verses.original: naanak vadaa aakhee-ai aapay jaanai aap.22
verses.translation: Nanak, call Him Great, for He Himself knows all. 22

verses.original: saalaahee saalaahi aytee surat na paa-ee-aa.
verses.translation: The wise men give a lot of advices, but this is not how they get to see him!

verses.original: nadee-aa atai vaah pavahi samund na jaanee-ahi.
verses.translation: The streams and rivers entering the ocean do not know its vastness.

verses.original: samund saah sultaan girhaa saytee maal Dhan.
verses.translation: Ocean sized kingdoms owners with mountains of material wealth.

verses.original: keerhee tul na hovnee jay tis manhu na veesrahi. 23
verses.translation: Even an ant outweighs them, if the Lord doesn’t dwell in their mind. 23

verses.original: ant na siftee kahan na ant. ant na karnai dayn na ant.
verses.translation: No end to God's praises; limit of praises can't be said. No end to his doings; No end to his gifts.

verses.original: ant na vaykhan sunan na ant. ant na jaapai ki-aa man mant.
verses.translation: No one has seen end to God; no one has heard his end; no end to those who meditate on him and holy minded.

verses.original: ant na jaapai keetaa aakaar. ant na jaapai paaraavaar.
verses.translation: No end to creatures he has shaped; No end to how many creations he nutures.

verses.original: ant kaaran kaytay billaahi. taa kay ant na paa-ay jaahi.
verses.translation: Many have sweared to have said limit of God; his limit cannot be found.

verses.original: ayhu ant na jaanai ko-ay. bahutaa kahee-ai bahutaa ho-ay.
verses.translation: No one knows his Limit. So many have tried to say and so many have come.

verses.original: vadaa saahib oochaa thaa-o. oochay upar oochaa naa-o.
verses.translation: Great is the Master high is His status. Highest of the High, and still higher is His Name.

verses.original: ayvad oochaa hovai ko-ay. tis oochay ka-o jaanai so-ay.
verses.translation: How great is he ? Only he himself knows that.

verses.original: jayvad aap jaanai aap aap. naanak nadree karmee daat. 24
verses.translation: Only He knows Himself. Nanak, may he bless us with the good karma. 24

verses.original: bahutaa karam likhi-aa naa jaa-ay. vadaa daataa til na tamaa-ay.
verses.translation: For many, he absolves them of their sins. The Great Giver does not hold anything back.

verses.original: kaytay mangahi joDh apaar.kayti-aa ganat nahee veechaar.
verses.translation: So many ask from God courageously. So many that cannot be counted.

verses.original: kaytay khap tutahi vaykaar. kaytay lai lai mukar paahi.
verses.translation: So many ask but don't receive. So many receive but deny that it is gifted from God

verses.original: kaytay moorakh khaahee khaahi. kayti-aa dookh bhookh sad maar.
verses.translation: So many fools keep continuously consuming God's gifts. So many endure pain, deprivation and constant abuse.

verses.original: ayhi bhe daat tayree daataar. band khalaasee bhaanai ho-ay.
verses.translation: Even these are Your Gifts, Great Giver! Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.

verses.original: hor aakh na sakai ko-ay. jay ko khaa-ik aakhan paa-ay. oh jaanai jaytee-aa muhi khaa-ay.
verses.translation: No one else has any say in this. If some fool should say otherwise, he certainly will have to eat his words.

verses.original: aapay jaanai aapay day-ay. aakhahi se bhe kay-ee kay-ay.
verses.translation: He Himself knows, He Himself gives. Few, very few acknowledge this.

verses.original: jis no bakhsay sifat saalaah. naanak paatisaahee paatisaahu. 25
verses.translation: One, who is blessed to sing His Praises Nanak, is the king of kings. 25

verses.original: amul gun amul vaapaar. amul vaapaaree-ay amul bhandaar.
verses.translation: Priceless are Virtues, Priceless are Dealings. Priceless are Dealers, Priceless are Treasures.

verses.original: amul aavahi amul lai jaahi. amul bhaa-ay amulaa samaahi.
verses.translation: Priceless are the comings; Priceless are taken away. Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless are absorbed.

verses.original: amul Dharam amul deebaan. amul tul amul parvaan.
verses.translation: Priceless is Dharma, Priceless is His Court. Priceless are the scales priceless are the weights.

verses.original: amul bakhsees amul neesaan. amul karam amul furmaan.
verses.translation: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is the Banner and Insignia. Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.

verses.original: amulo amul aakhi-aa na jaa-ay. aakh aakh rahay liv laa-ay.
verses.translation: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression! By repeating continually remain absorbed in His Love.

verses.original: aakhahi vayd paath puraan. aakhahi parhay karahi vakhi-aan. aakhahi barmay aakhahi ind.
verses.translation: The Vedas and Puraanas speak. The scholars speak and lecture. Brahma speaks Indra speaks.

verses.original: aakhahi gopee tai govind. aakhahi eesar aakhahi siDh. aakhahi kaytay keetay buDh.
verses.translation: The Gopis and Krishna speak. Shiva speaks the Siddhas speak. The many created Buddhas speak.

verses.original: aakhahi daanav aakhahi dayv. aakhahi sur nar mun jan sayv.
verses.translation: The demons speak the demi-gods speak. The warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble Sewadars speak.

verses.original: kaytay aakhahi aakhan paahi. kaytay kahi kahi uth uth jaahi.
verses.translation: Many say He is obtained by speaking. Many having spoken over and over have arisen and departed.

verses.original: aytay keetay hor karayhi. taa aakh na sakahi kay-ee kay-ay.
verses.translation: Having done all this, have it done again; even then, they could not describe Him.

verses.original: jayvad bhaavai tayvad ho-ay. naanak jaanai saachaa so-ay.
verses.translation: Whatever the Great one desires so shall transpire. O Nanak, Only the True Lord knows.

verses.original: jay ko aakhai boluvigaarh. taa likee-ai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar. 26
verses.translation: If anyone presumes to describe God, he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! 26

verses.original: so dar kayhaa so ghar kayhaa jit bahi sarab samaalay.
verses.translation: What is that Place like? What is the House like? Where that Lord resides?

verses.original: vaajay naad anayk asankhaa kaytay vaavanhaaray. kaytay raag paree si-o kahee-an kaytay gaavanhaaray.
verses.translation: Numerous Sound-currents vibrate simultaneously - Many musicians, So many melodious Ragas are sung – many are the singers?

verses.original: gaavahi tuhno pa-un paanee baisantar gaavai raajaa Dharam du-aaray.
verses.translation: Singing for You are the wind, water and fire; the King Dharma sings at Your Door.

verses.original: gaavahi chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh Dharam veechaaray.
verses.translation: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and subconscious who record actions sing; Dharma keeps writing, then thinks.

verses.original: gaavahi eesar barmaa dayvee sohan sadaa savaaray. gaavahi ind idaasan baithay dayviti-aa dar naalay.
verses.translation: Sing, Shiva, Brahma and Devi, beautifully decorated. Sing, Indra, seated upon His Throne, with the deities at Your Door.

verses.original: gaavahi siDh samaaDhee andar gaavan saaDh vichaaray.
verses.translation: Sing, Yogis in their posture/trance; the holy priests in contemplation.

verses.original: gaavan jatee satee santokhee gaavahi veer karaaray.gaavan pandit parhan rakheesar jug jug vaydaa naalay.
verses.translation: Sing, celibates, fanatics and the peaceful; Sing, the fearless warriors. Sing, Pandits, the religious scholars who have studied the Vedas for many ages.

verses.original: gaavahi mohnee-aa man mohan surgaa machh pa-i-aalay.
verses.translation: Sing, Mohinis, the enticer of hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious.

verses.original: gaavan ratan upaa-ay tayray athsath tirath naalay. gaavahi joDh mahaabal sooraa gaavahi khaanee chaaray.
verses.translation: Sing, celestial jewels created by You, with the 68 holy places of pilgrimage. Sing, brave mighty warriors, Sing, the four sources of creation.

verses.original: gaavahi khand mandal varbhandaa kar kar rakhay Dhaaray.
verses.translation: Sing, the planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand.

verses.original: say-ee tuDhuno gaavahi jo tuDh bhaavan ratay tayray bhagat rasaalay.
verses.translation: Only those alone sing, who yearn for You, Your immersed and purified Bhagats.

verses.original: hor kaytay gaavan say mai chit na aavan naanak ki-aa veechaaray.
verses.translation: Who else sings? I cannot remember. Nanak, has thought this.

verses.original: so-ee so-ee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naa-ee. hai bhee hosee jaa-ay na jaasee rachnaa jin rachaa-ee.
verses.translation: He and only He, the True Lord is always True and True is His Name. He is, and shall always be. He shall never depart - the Creator of the Universe.

verses.original: rangee rangee bhaatee kar kar jinsee maa-i-aa jin upaa-ee.
verses.translation: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

verses.original: kar kar vaykhai keetaa aapnaa jiv tis dee vadi-aa-ee. jo tis bhaavai so-ee karsee hukam na karnaa jaa-ee.
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness. He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

verses.original: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaa-ee. 27
verses.translation: He is the King - the King of kings. Nanak remains submissive to His Will. 27

verses.original: munda santokh saram pat jholee Dhi-aan kee karahi bibhoot.
verses.translation: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl and meditation the body ash.

verses.original: khinthaa kaal ku-aaree kaa-i-aa jugat dandaa parteet.
verses.translation: The thought of passing time as your mat; that turns a young unmarried girl to walk with a stick (old age).

verses.original: aa-ee panthee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet.
verses.translation: Oh traveller; all gathering; conquer your mind, and conquer the world.

verses.original: aadays tisai aadays.
verses.translation: Salutation! My humbly salutation to You.

verses.original: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug ayko vays. 28
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout time you remain same. 28

verses.original: bhugat gi-aan da-i-aa bhandaaran ghat ghat vaajeh naad.
verses.translation: Make wisdom your food and compassion your attendant; The Sound-current vibrates in each and every heart.

verses.original: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee riDh siDh avraa saad.
verses.translation: You are Supreme Lord of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are the tastes of others.

verses.original: sanjog vijog du-ay kaar chalaaveh laykhay aavahi bhaag.
verses.translation: Accompaniment and separation both drive the body and mind; whatever our fate bring.

verses.original: aadays tisai aadays.
verses.translation: Salutation! My humbly salutation to You.

verses.original: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug ayko vays. 29
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout time you remain same. 29

verses.original: aykaa maa-ee jugat vi-aa-ee tin chaylay parvaan.
verses.translation: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

verses.original: ik sansaaree ik bhandaaree ik laa-ay deebaan.
verses.translation: One the Creator of the World; One the Sustainer; and One the Destroyer.

verses.original: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furmaan.
verses.translation: Whatever He wishes, He makes to happen according to His Command.

verses.original: oh vaykhai onaa nadar na aavai bahutaa ayhu vidaan.
verses.translation: He watches all, but none see Him! How mysterious is this?

verses.original: aadays tisai aadays.
verses.translation: Salutation! My humbly salutation to You.

verses.original: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug ayko vays. 30
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout time you remain same. 30

verses.original: aasan lo-ay lo-ay bhandaar.
verses.translation: World upon world are His Seats of Authority and His Stores.

verses.original: jo kichh paa-i-aa so aykaa vaar.
verses.translation: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

verses.original: kar kar vaykhai sirjanhaar.
verses.translation: Having created the Universe, He watches over it.

verses.original: naanak sachay kee saachee kaar.
verses.translation: Nanak, This is the True Creator’s True Creation.

verses.original: aadays tisai aadays.
verses.translation: Salutation! My humbly salutation to You.

verses.original: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug ayko vays. 31
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout time you remain same. 31

verses.original: ik doo jeebhou lakh hohi lakh hoveh lakh vees.
verses.translation: From the one tongue, if I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied by twenty more.

verses.original: lakh lakh gayrhaa aakhee-ahi ayk naam jagdees.
verses.translation: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the One Name of the Creator.

verses.original: ayt raahi pat pavrhee-aa charhee-ai ho-ay ikees.
verses.translation: Tread this path to our Husband Lord, climbing these steps one merges with Him.

verses.original: sun galaa aakaas kee keetaa aa-ee rees.
verses.translation: Hearing of talks of the cosmos, even worms want to compete.

verses.original: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai koorhee koorhai thees. 32
verses.translation: Nanak, Only by His Grace is He obtained. The boastings of the false are a sham. 32

verses.original: aakhan jor chupai nah jor.
verses.translation: Creatures have no power to speak; no power to stay silent.

verses.original: jor na mangan dayn na jor.
verses.translation: no power to forcefully get something from God; cannot force God to give.

verses.original: jor na jeevan maran nah jor.
verses.translation: no power to live (when time is up); no power to die (all this is decided by God).

verses.original: jor na raaj maal man sor.
verses.translation: cannot force to become king, get rich and occult mental powers. (only who are destined by God shall receive if respectively)

verses.original: jor na surtee gi-aan veechaar.
verses.translation: Cannot force and become pretty, gain spiritual wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: jor na jugtee chhutai sansaar.
verses.translation: Cannot forcefully escape the cycle of life and death.

verses.original: jis hath jor kar vaykhai so-ay.
verses.translation: He who has all these powers, He watches over all and every time.

verses.original: naanak utam neech na ko-ay. 33
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one is high or low. 33

verses.original: raatee rutee thitee vaar. pavan paanee agnee paataal.
verses.translation: Nights, days, weeks and seasons; wind, water, fire and the nether regions

verses.original: tis vich Dhartee thaap rakhee Dharam saal. tis vich jee-a jugat kay rang.
verses.translation: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.Upon it, He placed creatures of various colors.

verses.original: tin kay naam anayk anant. karmee karmee ho-ay veechaar.
verses.translation: Their names are uncountable and endless. By their karams and deeds will they be judged.

verses.original: sachaa aap sachaa darbaar. tithai sohan panch parvaan.
verses.translation: God Himself is True, and True is His Court. There, in perfect grace sit the elect Controllers.

verses.original: nadree karam pavai neesaan. kach pakaa-ee othai paa-ay.
verses.translation: Through blessed Karmas, they receive their Mark. The ripe and the unripe shall be judged there.

verses.original: naanak ga-i-aa jaapai jaa-ay. 34
verses.translation: O Nanak, those go there who have worshipped. 34

verses.original: Dharam khand kaa ayho Dharam. gi-aan khand kaa aakhhu karam.
verses.translation: The Kingdom of Dharma has set rules. Speak of the qualities of the realm of knowledge.

verses.original: kaytay pavan paanee vaisantar kaytay kaan mahays.
verses.translation: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas

verses.original: kaytay barmay ghaarhat gharhee-ahi roop rang kay vays.
verses.translation: So many Brahmas fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

verses.original: kaytee-aa karam bhoomee mayr kaytay kaytay Dhoo updays.
verses.translation: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

verses.original: kaytay ind chand soor kaytay kaytay mandal days.
verses.translation: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

verses.original: kaytay siDh buDh naath kaytay kaytay dayvee vays.
verses.translation: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

verses.original: kaytay dayv daanav mun kaytay kaytay ratan samund.
verses.translation: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

verses.original: kaytee-aa khaanee kaytee-aa banee kaytay paat narind.
verses.translation: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

verses.original: kaytee-aa surtee sayvak kaytay naanak ant na ant. 35
verses.translation: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, Limitless is His limit! 35

verses.original: gi-aan khand meh gi-aan parchand.
verses.translation: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

verses.original: tithai naad binod kod anand.
verses.translation: The Sound current vibrates amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

verses.original: saram khand kee banee roop.
verses.translation: In the realm of humility the beautiful Bani reigns.

verses.original: tithai ghaarhat gharhee-ai bahut anoop.
verses.translation: Forms of incomparable beauty are created and fashioned there.

verses.original: taa kee-aa galaa kathee-aa naa jaahi.
verses.translation: These things cannot be described.

verses.original: jay ko kahai pichhai pachhutaa-ay.
verses.translation: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

verses.original: tithai gharhee-ai surat mat man buDh.
verses.translation: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

verses.original: tithai gharhee-ai suraa siDhaa kee suDh. 36
verses.translation: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. 36

verses.original: karam khand kee banee jor. tithai hor na ko-ee hor.
verses.translation: In the realm of karma, the Bani is Power. Nothing else can prevail here.

verses.original: tithai joDh mahaabal soor. tin meh raam rahi-aa bharpoor.
verses.translation: The warriors of great power and immense courage. In whom Ram dwells and is infused completely.

verses.original: tithai seeto seetaa mahimaa maahi. taa kay roop na kathnay jaahi.
verses.translation: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory, Their physical features are beyond description.

verses.original: naa ohi mareh na thaagay jaahi. jin kai raam vasai man maahi.
verses.translation: Neither do they die nor can they be robbed, within whose minds the Lord Ram resides.

verses.original: tithai bhagat vaseh kay lo-a. karahi anand sachaa man so-ay.
verses.translation: The devotees of many worlds dwell there. They are in bliss; the True Lord dwells in their minds.

verses.original: sach khand vasai nirankaar. kar kar vaykhai nadar nihaal.
verses.translation: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides. Having created, He watches over the Creation bestowing Grace and happiness.

verses.original: tithai khand mandal varbhand. jay ko kathai ta ant na ant.
verses.translation: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies. If one describes them, there is no limit, no end.

verses.original: tithai lo-a lo-a aakaar. jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar.
verses.translation: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation. As He commands, so they exist.

verses.original: vaykhai vigsai kar veechaar. naanak kathnaa karrhaa saar. 37
verses.translation: He watches, contemplates and rejoices upon His Creation O Nanak, description is extremely difficult! 37

verses.original: jat paahaaraa Dheeraj suni-aar.
verses.translation: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

verses.original: ahran mat vayd hathee-aar.
verses.translation: Let understanding be the anvil, and religious wisdom the tools.

verses.original: bha-o khalaa agan tap taa-o.
verses.translation: Fear of God the bellows; fan the flames of your body's inner heat.

verses.original: bhaaNdaa bhaa-o amrit tit dhaal.
verses.translation: In the crucible of love, melt the Amrit Nectar of the Naam,

verses.original: gharhee-ai sabad sachee taksaal.
verses.translation: Forge the Shabad in the True mint.

verses.original: jin ka-o nadar karam tin kaar.
verses.translation: Whoever is showered with His Grace, karma of their actions excel.

verses.original: naanak nadree nadar nihaal. 38
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord’s Glance uplifts and rescues them. 38

verses.original: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa Dharat mahat.
verses.translation: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

verses.original: divas raat du-ay daa-ee daa-i-aa khaylai sagal jagat.
verses.translation: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap the entire world is at play.

verses.original: chang-aa-ee-aa buri-aa-ee-aa vaachai Dharam hadoor.
verses.translation: Good deeds and bad are announced in the Presence of Lord Dharma.

verses.original: karmee aapo aapnee kay nayrhai kay door.
verses.translation: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

verses.original: jinee naam Dhi-aa-i-aa ga-ay maskat ghaal.
verses.translation: Those who have meditated on the Naam have departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

verses.original: naanak tay mukh ujlay kaytee chhutee naal.
verses.translation: O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Lord’s Court, and many are saved along with them!
